title: Slow English Podcast #345: 20 Easy Facts About Afghanistan

sentences.text: Today we will learn about a country with a long and interesting history.
The country is Afghanistan.
I will speak slowly and use easy English.
Fact one, Afghanistan is in Asia.
Afghanistan is a country in Central and South Asia.
It is surrounded by mountains and deserts.
It does not have a coast or a beach.
Many different countries are its neighbors.
Afghanistan has an important location between East Asia, Central Asia, and the Middle East.
For many years, traders traveled through this country.
Fact two, the capital city is Kabul.
Kabul is the largest city in Afghanistan.
It is also the capital city.
Millions of people live there.
Kabul has schools, universities, markets, and hospitals.
The city has been an important place for hundreds of years.
Many roads from different parts of the country meet in Kabul.
Fact three, Afghanistan has many mountains.
The country is famous for its mountains.
The Hindu Kush mountains cross much of Afghanistan.
Some mountains are very high.
Many villages are built in mountain valleys.
The mountains are beautiful in every season.
In winter, many mountain tops are covered with snow.
Fact four, Afghanistan has a long history.
People have lived in Afghanistan for thousands of years.
Many ancient civilizations lived there.
The country was an important stop on the Silk Road.
Merchants traveled with silk, spices, and other goods.
Many cultures met in Afghanistan.
Because of this, the country has a rich history.
Fact five, the official languages are Dari and Pashto.
Most people speak Dari or Pashto.
Many people can also speak other local languages.
Children learn these languages at school.
Different regions have different traditions and ways of speaking.
Language is an important part of Afghan culture.
Fact six, family is very important.
Families are often large.
Grandparents, parents, and children spend time together.
People help and support each other.
Family celebrations are important.
Respect for older family members is a strong tradition.
Fact seven, Afghan food is delicious.
Many meals include rice, bread, vegetables, and meat.
People also enjoy yogurt and fresh herbs.
One famous dish is called kabouli pula.
It is made with rice, carrots, raisins, and meat.
Many families enjoy eating together.
Sharing food is an important tradition.
Fact eight, tea is very popular.
Many people drink tea every day.
Tea is served to guests.
People often sit together and talk while drinking tea.
Green tea and black tea are both common.
Offering tea is a sign of hospitality.
Fact nine, Afghanistan has beautiful nature.
There are mountains, rivers, valleys, and deserts.
In spring, many places become green.
Wildflowers grow in the countryside.
Nature changes with the seasons.
Many people enjoy the beautiful landscapes.
Fact 10, the country has many old buildings.
Afghanistan has ancient mosques, forts, and historical sites.
Some buildings are hundreds of years old.
These places tell the story of the country's past.
Visitors enjoy learning about Afghan history and architecture.
Fact 11, carpets from Afghanistan are famous.
Afghan carpets are handmade.
People spend many months making one carpet.
Each carpet has beautiful colors and patterns.
These carpets are sold in many countries.
They are known for their high quality.
Fact 12, fruit grows in many parts of Afghanistan.
The country produces grapes, pomegranates, apricots, cherries, and almonds.
Many fruits are sweet and fresh.
Farmers work hard every year.
Agriculture is important for many families.
Fact 13, bread is part of every meal.
Bread is called naan.
People eat naan with many different foods.
Fresh bread is baked every day.
Many families buy warm bread from local bakeries.
Bread is one of the most important foods in Afghanistan.
Fact 14, markets are full of life.
Traditional markets are called bazaars.
People buy clothes, food, spices, carpets, and handmade products.
The markets are colorful and busy.
Many people enjoy visiting them.
The bazaar is an important part of daily life.
Fact 15, Afghanistan has four seasons.
Spring is green and colorful.
Summer can be very hot.
Autumn is cool and pleasant.
Winter brings snow to many mountain areas.
Each season has its own beauty.
Fact 16, hospitality is very important.
Afghan people are known for welcoming guests.
Visitors are often offered tea and food.
People enjoy spending time together.
Kindness and respect are important values.
Guests are treated with great care.
Fact 17, traditional clothing is colorful.
Many people wear traditional clothes during festivals and family celebrations.
The clothes are comfortable and beautiful.
Some have colorful embroidery.
Traditional clothing shows local culture and history.
Fact 18, music is part of Afghan culture.
People enjoy traditional music.
Many songs tell stories about life, family, and love.
Traditional instruments create beautiful sounds.
Music is played during celebrations and weddings.
Fact 19, many people enjoy sports.
Football is popular.
Cricket is also one of the favorite sports.
Children enjoy playing outside with friends.
Sports bring people together.
Many young people dream of becoming professional athletes.
Fact 20, Afghanistan is a country with rich history and beautiful landscapes.
It has mountains, rivers, ancient cities, colorful markets, and strong traditions.
The country has a unique culture that has developed over thousands of years.
Many people hope to visit Afghanistan one day to learn more about its history and natural beauty.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
I hope you learned something new today.
Keep listening, keep practicing, and keep enjoying English.
